s00545.summary: Blythe lectures the Constable on taxidermy while he asks about the missing curator.
Fitch steps alive from behind the Great Elk, claiming he merely fell asleep.
Hargrove spots bloodied tweed in the antlers while Blythe's candle shakes.

s02418.summary: Lenore tells Derrick to stay silent at arraignment as he protests his innocence.
Calloway orders quiet, and Derrick snaps back at the deputy.
Lenore touches Derrick's knee and he calms; Calloway glimpses sympathy in the mirror.

s01157.summary: Six survivors share ration biscuits on a lifeboat at dawn.
Nan points out a smudge of smoke, and the others debate what it is.
Tolliver admits he has had a flare in his pocket all night.
Tolliver fires the flare, and crimson smoke fills the boat.
Nan laughs, Mei cries, and a mast rises on the horizon.

s00694.summary: Ray says the money is short; Lazlo keeps counting, insisting it is four thousand.
Ray notices Lazlo's sweat and double counting, then senses someone behind the fabric.
Ray draws his revolver, and a teenage boy steps out clutching cash.

s00363.summary: Ivo pries open a steel case in the seed vault under Nora's timer.
Ivo inspects the vial, finds the label wrong, and moves to the next case.
A siren starts; Ivo slips and barely catches the falling vial.
Nora has Ivo turn to face a rifle; she betrayed him for better pay.

s01704.summary: Nellie meets new hire Percival on his first day as Hector chimes in.
The intercom reports a mamba loose, and Nellie shuts her eyes.
They tangle in the doorway, then scatter down the hall as more animals escape.

s00250.summary: Oksana keeps repairing the coupling, stonewalling the bridge's status request.
Simeon floats in and relays the captain's order to come up.
Comms reports an unknown object matching their heading, twelve kilometers away.
Oksana sees a shape too regular to be debris behind the wreck.
Oksana answers they are coming up and follows Simeon out.

s01822.summary: The cage stalls in the shaft; Casimir and Leila trade blame about the guide rails.
A metallic groan rises from below and a light sweeps up through the grating.
Dominik climbs up the rails, scolds Casimir, and ties Leila to the cage.
Dominik warns the cable is fraying at the third splice; the cage drops an inch.
Casimir pulls the lever and the cage climbs; a hard hat falls into darkness.

s01411.summary: Strangers wait out a flight delay at a rainy airport gate.
Finn chats with Mina, who admits she is flying to her own wedding.
The old couple bicker over whether Mina is nervous, and Finn and Mina laugh.
Mina describes her kind fiance with hesitation; Finn pockets a folded note.
Boarding is announced; Mina sits by Finn and he admits fear of staying.
Esme urges them to decide; Mina removes her ring and Finn closes her hand.

s01608.summary: Five passengers and a porter sit in a swaying dining car.
Diners talk over each other while Odalys insists she is perfectly fine.
A glass shatters, and Desmond finds a brass key; Odalys silently begs him.
Desmond closes his hand over the key and says nothing.

s02518.summary: Coach Archibald drills the crew at dawn while Anselm ties his shoes slowly.
Archibald warns of the rival's stroke rate and notes the crew's clean rowing.
Dolores says they are never as bad as they think; Archibald praises her.
Archibald orders the boat on the water and the crew lifts the shell.

s00960.summary: Captain Brynhild rations biscuits on the frozen lifeboat, saving a quarter for Temperance.
Temperance wakes and asks if it is warm; Fina gently says no.
Hiram hears an engine, but Fina dismisses it as wind.
A rescue helicopter resolves from the speck; Hiram weeps and Brynhild lifts the flare gun.

s00846.summary: A furtive man with a briefcase enters the car wash while Duke and Rhoda watch.
Inspector Rhoda questions the man, who gives his name as Boone.
Rhoda makes Boone open the briefcase, revealing stacks of cash.
Duke arms himself with a squeegee and asks crossword clues; both stare at him.

s00414.summary: Council inspector Samuel enters Perpetua's tiny tea shop and is offered tea.
Samuel cites a sign size violation; Perpetua serenely asks which code.
Perpetua pours tea and Samuel wavers between the law and the cup.
Samuel sips, loves the tea, sets down his clipboard, and stays.

s01291.summary: The groom, bride and chef panic over the cake with the ceremony an hour away.
Donna on the phone insists the cake flower is a sunflower.
Ludwik slices off the offending flower, and Chloe flings her bouquet.
Chloe proposes they elope, and Ludwik hands them slices of sunflower.

s00053.summary: Ray calls a last-minute Friday sync while Delphine and Quentin look on.
Ray draws three circles on the whiteboard and delights in his Triple Loop.
Delphine announces she's going home; loyal Quentin stays, and she tells him to run.

s02428.summary: Operators work the switchboards as Nell connects a caller.
Adelaide listens in and hears the caller say the bank is on fire.
Adelaide orders the fire brigade called, and the operators connect in unison.
Shaking Nell is reassured by Adelaide, and the room exhales.

s00636.summary: Sabina and Felix run a final MRI sequence while Armando jokes through the speaker.
Sabina goes quiet as the images reveal something serious and bilateral.
Sabina tells Armando everything's fine; Felix turns the monitor away from the glass.

s02359.summary: Voss lies silent in a shell crater at dawn.
Dobos crawls in, says the enemy is gone, and steadies his shaking hand.
A scrape of stone freezes them as a child rises behind the wall.
The child offers grapes; Voss lowers his rifle and Dobos eats one.

s01336.summary: Alaric and Brynjolf meet in the middle of a frozen waterfall bridge.
The rivals trade terse lines, each demanding the other yield passage.
They speak in unison, smile, and lower their weapons as a crack spreads.
Brynjolf pulls Alaric clear as an ice pillar shatters, and they grapple.
The bridge is breaking, so they agree to cross together and help each other up.

s00831.summary: Detective Kowalczyk browses Lou's pawn shop while nervous Artie glances at the desk.
She shows an engraved watch tied to a drowned man, and Lou closes the drawer.
Lou sends fumbling Artie home; the detective sits and tells Lou to take his time.

s00082.summary: Staff man a call center in a haunted-house decor, until every line goes dead.
Pale VP Darius glides in and asks who scared the callers away.
Kenji points at the skeleton; Darius praises Hollis and the phones ring.

s01563.summary: Seraphina and the Ferrywoman wait on a jetty among floating lanterns as a shadow wades near.
The shadow climbs up as a gaunt young man and greets Seraphina; the Ferrywoman warns her.
Seraphina demands her brother; the Shadow says he is now a lantern.
The Shadow offers a year of her life for a year of her brother's.
The Ferrywoman demands his name; he says Orren and the lanterns flare.

s01828.summary: Priya rewires a panel as falling pressure and Helmut hover nearby.
Helmut holds the penlight for Priya without being thanked.
The drone reminds them the capsule holds two and the habitat holds three.
Helmut touches her wrist and writes a list of names for the capsule.
Priya covers the wet list and tells the drone to report they are fine.
The pressure holds; Helmut sits beside her and they quietly trade percentages.

s01287.summary: Four exhausted people wade single file through a mangrove swamp.
Elspeth freezes the group as something large surfaces and slides under a root.
They whisper about the creature while feverish Henrik asks to sit.
Elspeth explains the left bank is safer; her husband took the right.
Fireflies appear; Yusuf calls them beautiful and Henrik says malaria.
A splash behind them sends the linked group plunging across the channel.
They collapse on the far bank, relieved, then learn two miles remain.

s00386.summary: Auctioneer Giles opens bidding on a brig in a crowded tavern.
Marguerite and Captain Silas trade rising bids while Jeb protests.
The room hushes as Silas and Marguerite stare, and he bids ninety.
Marguerite puts everything she owns on the block and wins the brig.

s02170.summary: The crew fights a sealed hatch and dropping pressure on a failing ship.
Mira spots a stowaway child in the vent, while Kozlov brushes her off.
Something moves fast in the bulkhead and buckles it as everyone panics.

s00749.summary: Five people find an uninvited soaked girl in the dark workshop.
The girl points at the stuffed stag and says he said she could sleep in him.
She gives her name as Pia; the stag's head lowers as she says he's warm.
